Reporting a problem

Güven Phone Help Guide, version 2.0.22

Open Report a problem at the top of Settings.

Describe the problem briefly if you like.

Send lets you send the report with an app you choose, such as email. Save to file saves the report on the phone.

The report contains app and device information and a short log of recent events. It contains no names, phone numbers or messages.

While a problem is being looked into, you may be asked to turn on Detailed diagnostic log; it is in Troubleshooting (Diagnostics) at the end of Settings.
